limits: Mutation windows are invocation-through-Promise settlement, not isolated queue/admission/engine CPU.
Invocation-return includes synchronous ownership/admission/first pump; remainder is not pure queue wait.
Sequence windows retain clocks/vectors/receipts/immutable roots, affecting resource lifetime; no overhead subtraction or pure unobserved batch claim.
Reset and verification run in the same process outside windows and can warm analyzer/JIT; first/repeated is not coldmachine.
No per-call sequence pooling to manufacture100-observation p95; batchthroughput stays whole-window per fixed B.
Fresh/cached/selected query verification scopes remain separate from measured mutation latency and current-root query admission.
Current/accepted bytes are equal; observed variations are controls, not additional optimization.
